description: September 7 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 2, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 7 birthday falls in Virgo, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a September 7 birthday
paragraphs: The 7th of September pairs one of the most inward numbers with one of the most exacting signs. Fourteen degrees of Virgo falls in the Saturn decan, adding reserve and endurance, and the birthday number 7 points towards reflection, inquiry and time alone. The blend tends to produce a specialist's temperament: happiest going deep into one subject until it finally makes sense.

By noon UTC on September 7, the Sun has normally reached roughly 14° of Virgo. That places the date in the Virgo decan that astrologers give to Saturn, the second of three. From 10 to 19 degrees of Virgo the sub-ruler is Saturn, which also rules Capricorn. Early-to-mid September birthdays therefore combine Virgo's attention to detail with a serious, long-term sense of responsibility. These natives are frequently described as dependable, disciplined and drawn to work that matters over years rather than weeks. They may carry duties others have dropped, without complaining about it. Saturn can also bring self-doubt and a reluctance to celebrate small wins. Allowing progress to count before it is complete often helps this decan enjoy the sturdy structures it is so good at building.

sections.heading: Numerology of the September 7 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 7th, you have a birthday number of 7 in its plain form. Numerology treats the birth day as a secondary influence, often visible in how a person thinks rather than what they do. The 7 has long been regarded as the seeker's number, linked with analysis, solitude and questions that do not have quick answers. Natives of the 7th are frequently described as observant, private and happiest when they can go deep into a subject. Time alone tends to recharge them, and trust in their intuition often grows as they learn when to stop overthinking.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same September 7 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: September 7 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 7 is the 250th day of the year (251st in a leap year). In most years Libra season is under way by September 23, 16 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 7 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. September 7 is also the birthday of Georges-Louis Leclerc, Comte de Buffon (1707), Elia Kazan (1909) and Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan (1948).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 7?
faq.answer: September 7 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 7?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 7 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 7th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 7?
faq.answer: By September 7 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 7?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a September 7 birthday are Georges-Louis Leclerc, Comte de Buffon (1707), Elia Kazan (1909) and Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan (1948). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
